chronicConditions.name: Sickle cell trait (heterozygous HbAS)
chronicConditions.notes: Asymptomatic carrier. Rare exertional hematuria. Increased risk of rhabdomyolysis and splenic infarction at altitude/extreme heat — heat precautions emphasized.

chronicConditions.name: Primary hypothyroidism
chronicConditions.notes: Post-Hashimoto's thyroiditis. TSH 2.1 at last check (Jan 2025) — well controlled on levothyroxine.

allergies.reaction: Nausea and vomiting (no rash, no respiratory involvement)

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Aminu Bello, Family Medicine — Ahmadu Bello University Teaching Hospital, Zaria
clinicalNotes.content: Pre-Hajj clearance. Patient screened thoroughly given sickle cell trait. Counseled in Hausa re: extreme hydration goals (3-4 L/day in Mecca), avoid strenuous Tawaf during midday heat, recognize warning signs of rhabdomyolysis (dark urine, severe muscle pain). Provided written aftercare card in English and Hausa.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Funke Adeyemi, Endocrinology
clinicalNotes.content: Routine thyroid follow-up. TSH 2.1, free T4 normal. Continue 75 mcg dose. No symptoms of over- or under-replacement. Patient reports good adherence.

demoPresentingComplaint.ar: دوار خفيف وصداع بعد الطواف. الأعراض تتحسن مع الراحة والسوائل.
demoPresentingComplaint.en: Mild dizziness and headache after completing Tawaf. Symptoms improving with rest and oral fluids.
